kb_group_exclusion: all story groups containing any preauth-no-kb training row
coverage_bucket: annotation action plus sorted normalized missing_slots
allocation: reserve one row per nonempty bucket, distribute remainder proportionally to its residual unique-row capacity after fixed group exposure by integer largest remainder, lexical tie break; shared group exhaustion fails without relaxation
selection: seeded story-group round robin without replacement within each bucket, global caps include fixed authenticated exposure; fail without relaxing if infeasible
ordering: independent local seeded RNG; shuffle selected IDs within each preauth segment and shuffled no_kb/no_kb/kb pattern in each original20-position block
interpretation: combined preauth capability allocation, bucket coverage, group exclusion and group sampling change; not a pure single-factor quota effect
unchanged_if_later_trained: official fresh0.8B, same initial seed/LoRA,400-step LR/loss/gates; requires separately reviewed new execution protocol; never load this into old frozen runner
